Back in middle and high school I would often spend Friday night at a LAN party. My group of friends would all take our computers over to one of our houses, drink sickening amounts of Mt. In my senior year of high school, that same kid sat behind me in English. One day I couldn't help but overhear him talking to another kid about his group of friends all getting together and a few of them bringing their Xboxes with them so they could play Halo all night.

I stopped what I was doing, turned around, and point blank ask him, "Oh, so you're going to have a LAN party?" I explained he was going to take his Xbox, which is a computer, to a friend's house to play games, that's a LAN party.
